info.name: Umuganda Management System - Midterm Examination
info.description: AUCA INSY 8322 WEB TECHNOLOGY AND INTERNET | Student: MUGENI Cynthia | ID: 26600 | Project: Umuganda Management System. Set baseUrl to http://localhost:8080. Run requests in collection order. Run the query folders B and C before D and E mutations. A2 CRUD test folders run after C4 and before D1; they create temporary records, capture IDs from Get All, update them, and delete them without changing seed records. For E1-E3, run E1, then E2, then E3 Delete activity (409), then E3 Delete report (success). The collection assumes the original seed database described in the examination.
